description: Odds that changed since a Unix timestamp (at most 90 seconds old) for one bookmaker and sport, limited to the markets you name. A delta: only changed markets are returned. For polling code, not for one-off questions (use get_odds instead).

markets.description: Comma-separated market names, max 40 (e.g. 'ML,Spread,Totals'). Required. Use get_markets for the exact names.

since.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, at most 90 seconds old

name: get_updated_odds
title: Odds changed since
